baseline: Verified 5d8c8da; ASG closed permanently as a negative result; no ASG rerun
pretraining_amendment: cf4fb73 corpus construction rejected 'equally many uses' as a weighting keyword under the unchanged CBF5 compiler; replace only 'equally many' with 'the same number of' in its two reversal partners before any model result. Original partial evidence retained at parent root. Fresh stock encoder instantiated before adaptation to avoid inherited inference-mode caches; labels, meanings, gates, architecture and training recipe unchanged.
hypothesis: Joint criterion/schema self-attention supports ternary relations that independent frozen geometry failed to ground; head or one-layer adaptation may recover fresh signed transfer.
primary_metric: Fresh final joint signed-atom accuracy; all G0-G7 required, then frozen-architecture seed replication before any promotion.
secondary_metrics: all four-by-three uncalibrated softmax relation matrices
evidence_policy: Every conclusion is labeled MEASURED, INFERENCE or HYPOTHESIS. Softmax matrices are uncalibrated class mass, not validated probabilities or certificates.

replication.trigger: Only if selected seed7 architecture passes every fresh G0-G7 gate
replication.architecture: Freeze architecture, source/splits, training recipe, checkpoint rule and decoder; retrain seeds11/13 without final-dependent choice; report all seeds; require every seed to pass before promotion
replication.failure: No promotion; run a preregistered targeted stability/transfer audit and the mandate's evidence-triggered next branch

failure_branches.axis_low_sign_high: Training-only schema descriptions/paraphrases and contrastive field discrimination; no final alias phrases in descriptions
failure_branches.axis_high_sign_low: Reversal equivariance then explicit comparative relations or signed pair ranking
failure_branches.both_low_after_C: Controlled current small open relation/cross-encoder bake-off, selected by license/size/semantic quality/context/multilingual potential; no huge generative jump
failure_branches.fixed_schema_pass_unseen_field_fail: Ephemeral Criterion Atoms with exact compiler/executor around candidate-atom semantics

artifacts: git revision and environment before fitting
pair tokens and frozen CLS features
pair_format: Native tokenizer(criterion, text_pair=canonical_field): CLS criterion SEP field SEP. Final-layer raw CLS. No definitions, alias words, field IDs, weights or labels in schema input.

training.source: Only corrected CBF-4 stratum=train literal criteria, atomized under original exact grammar; strip numeric weights while retaining polarity. No alias or final labels used.
training.validation: Literal training templates atomic/4,atomic/5,composition/4,composition/5 reserved; remove every validation atom text from training regardless of originating template. Group by exact atom text to prevent split leakage.
training.G0: All32 existing held literal polarity questions: four unseen atomic templates x eight signed directions. No G0 labels used for optimizer/checkpoint selection. Diagnostic neural resolution only; runtime literal path remains exact.
training.feature_preprocess: Training-only per-coordinate mean and std; std floor0.01. Identical fixed preprocessing for both frozen heads. Affine preprocessing is foldable into each first linear layer; record parameters.
training.checkpoint: Lowest unweighted validation cross-entropy; deterministic earlier-epoch tie. Alias/G0/final outcomes never select checkpoints, hyperparameters or training epochs.
training.nonlinear: 384->64->GELU->3, biases; no extra normalization or dropout

progression.selection_split: Existing32 aliases and existing50 alias compositions are development-only. Mirror G1-G7 point thresholds on these old questions; G0 on held literal templates. Final outcomes NEVER trigger additional arms.
progression.A: Train linear frozen-pair head first. If all development gates pass, select it and skip B/C.
progression.B: Only if A fails development gates: exactly one frozen MLP control, same pairs, labels, preprocessing, seed, optimizer, budget and checkpoint rule. If it passes select it and skip C.
progression.C: Only if A and B fail: same linear relation head architecture as A, initialized from A selected checkpoint; same stock base encoder; unfreeze only last transformer layer, all other parameters frozen. Encoder kept eval for deterministic dropout-free frozen prefix; gradients enabled through final layer. No LoRA, second layer or architecture changes.

C_recipe.checkpoint: Lowest unweighted literal-validation cross-entropy, never dev/final selection of epoch

progression.rev_trigger: After each plain arm, only if G0>=.95, development axis>=.85, conditional sign>=.75 and <.90, joint>=.65, alias decisions>=.65, composition decisions>=.65: one secondary reversal-equivariant run with same architecture/training budget and literal data. No final-based trigger.
progression.rev_loss: CE + 0.1*mean squared probability distance p(q+,field) versus [p+(q-),p0(q-),p-(q-)] on meaning-reversed literal training pairs only; no alias labels. Freeze template-pair construction before training.
progression.rev_limit: At most one secondary reversal arm, first eligible plain stage only. Plain CE is always scored first; retain plain if both pass. No antipodal embedding objective.
progression.final_selection: First development-passing arm in stage order, preferring plain over reversal. If none pass, choose highest development joint-atom accuracy, then alias-decision accuracy, then simpler/earlier arm to measure one unsuccessful candidate on final. Open final only once after stage selection. No later arms or repairs chosen from final outcomes.
progression.budget_comparability: Frozen A/B share recipe. C changes encoder adaptation, initialization and optimization rates; evidence is within-stage operational capability, not an isolated encoder-only causal effect. Seed7 is a screen; seeds11/13 replication is required if it passes.

final_corpus.meaning: Every atom axis/sign and every reversal pair checked before training; independent blind audit must agree or ambiguous phrasing repaired and rehashed BEFORE any training/model outcomes.
final_corpus.lexical: No literal schema names, no normalized full phrase duplicates or complete old alias phrase inclusion. Persist content-word Jaccard and shared ngram overlap against CBF4/5 aliases and training literals. Shared ordinary words allowed; no post-result filtering.
final_corpus.compositions: Fixed two-term joins of fresh atoms across all six unordered axis pairs, signs and exact unit/double weights; same frozen compiler grammar. Gold decomposition labels diagnostic only.
final_corpus.freeze: Protocol, corpus generator, training atomizer and pair formatting committed before building/encoding; final corpus bytes, hashes, meaning/overlap audit committed before training. Model never reads final labels for fitting, selection or stage triggers.

decoder: For four ternary distributions, classify each row by argmax with class order lower,unrelated,higher. UNKNOWN if all four rows predict unrelated. Otherwise select axis with largest max(p_lower,p_higher)-p_unrelated among rows predicting nonzero; canonical axis tie; sign from its ternary argmax. Persist ALL four-by-three probabilities, row classes, chosen axis/sign and number of nonzero fields. No tuned thresholds or oracle axis.
compiler: Reuse schema_grounding_compiler unchanged. Neural callback only for unknown semantic atoms. Exact outer factors multiply signed basis vectors; UNKNOWN propagates. Candidate states/facts unchanged; integer-percent field sum and content tie-break unchanged.
causal: Lexicographically first visible alias-containing question per positive coefficient ray; ordered distinct-ray swaps on same32 CBF4 test states, filter only teacher concrete winner changing. Correct-new equality is gate; student_changed, both endpoints and teacher-top-set are separate diagnostics, not requirements.
uncertainty: Final alias axis/joint and paired decision accuracies:10000 seed0 bootstrap draws over64 opposite-meaning pairs; conditional sign ratio undefined when no correct axes. Nominal95% intervals descriptive only; gates use preregistered point thresholds. Candidate rows and swaps are dependent. Final compositions use64 reversal-paired question groups; report exact counts. No comparison superiority claim based on repeated old aliases.
verification: Runtime smoke nonzero head/final-layer gradients, frozen parameter hashes unchanged, train/final text sets disjoint, four schema fields only, no input truncation. Independent saved-probability decoder/coefficient/integer-score reconstruction, literal no-neural callback, exact reversed+seed7 shuffled permutation proof, causal definition and all final gates.
B_STEF_rule: Even if SRE passes, no old B-STEF launch. First separately establish a foldable deployment equivalent for the winning pair-relation architecture; encoder adaptation requires optimizer reformulation.
forbidden: LoRA or two-layer adaptation in this study
